Removing or repairing that prior removed both inspected stripe failures; useful process/shape quality still did not meet the goal.

In the replay, execution C token cosine was approximately0.93 while routing C was0.35-0.38; combined state/output writes reached0.975-0.998. This does not isolate output O alone or establish across-sample collapse.

design.change: One C with independent physical K and V projections
design.mechanism: Use the R1/R9 shared semantic/physical content mechanism. Generation and the existing word-alignment loss act on the same C; remove the separate freely drifting execution memory.
design.support: R1/R9 retain stronger joint/comprehensive behavior than high-PC but weak-SA split-memory variants. Current E shows that varied routing alone does not ensure useful writes.
design.limitation: This is a causal design hypothesis, not proof that tying C alone explains historical differences or guarantees higher PC.

design.change: Grounded words plus full frozen-Qwen image/request/reasoning memory
design.mechanism: Relation-local heads preserve specific physical words; global heads regain direct access to the complete input context as in R1. Input memory is not generated again or API-revised.
design.support: Dedicated request-only refinement did not establish benefit in E; R1 full-context conditioning is a useful measured reference.
design.limitation: Full-context use requires own16 words-only-memory intervention; contextual word tokens already contain some image/request information.

design.change: Physical residual first, then unchanged native text attention on the updated real hidden state
design.mechanism: Keep direct physical values, state interaction and trainable independent physical Q/K/V/O. Recompute native norm3 after the physical residual and use the frozen native text reader; no semantic-log-prior product or added gate.
design.support: In E, no-C restores semantic/visual behavior; parallel physical updates can dominate the native text update. The new composition gives generation gradients an explicit path through the native semantic response to the physical write.
design.limitation: This order was not established superior by prior D post-text-read controls; compare normal/parallel on the same trained F checkpoint.
